summary: Clean the neighborhood gardens in this arcade-style MAZE GAME!
description:
Help Charlie clean up the neighborhood gardens in this arcade-style maze game.

Controls are simple! Just SWIPE any direction to get Charlie moving. Each tile you clean up rewards you with points.
Run long streaks to score extra combos, but make sure not to bump into the animals strolling around the various gardens.

SUNDAY LAWN SEASONS is the sequel to fan-favorite Sunday Lawn!
Whereas the original game had you mowing grass in the summer, this sequel will let you PLOW SNOW during winter, BLOW LEAVES during autumn and FERTILIZE in the spring.

HIGHLIGHTS

- 180 LEVELS across THREE SEASONS* - Autumn, winter, spring

- Charming retro style graphics

- LEVEL SELECTOR with Donut Games' famous 3-star system for increased REPLAY VALUE

- Lifesavers to help you pass levels if you get stuck

- JOYPAD and KEYBOARD support

* The game is free from ads. 10 autumn levels are included and playable at no cost.
A premium upgrade is provided as an optional one-time in-app purchase, for anyone who'd like all game modes and levels.

* * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * * *

Enjoy another playful Donut Games original!
